market_portfolios.how_to_read: Values are FantasyCalc dynasty trade values (superflex, 12 teams, full PPR). move30 = 30-day market move of the players held now (trade-neutral). since_change = change since the snapshot dated `since` (includes trades). sidelined = value on IR/Out/PUP. Status flags: crash, correction, stable, bull.

trade_finder.how: Each suggestion comes from the Trade Finder logic: one side has a real need (the offered players would raise its starting lineup) or, for a rebuilder, the deal fits its timeline; the two sides are within 10% in FantasyCalc market value; each team is read as a contender, retooling or rebuilder. Build the issue's hypothetical trades from these (a and b are the two managers; as/bs are already in issue wording, keep them as written so the values and the Load in trade calculator link work). Write the desk commentary yourself; do not invent assets or values.

desk: Sarge71 set the best lineup his roster could field, 94.8, left nothing on the bench, and lost to YesChef23 by 46.54. YesChef23's 141.34 was the top score of the week, with Matthew Golden at 32.4 and Darren Waller the TE of the week at 23. Sarge71 is 1-8 and 12th. A perfect lineup adds its full score to MAXPF (the points a perfect lineup would have scored each week, added up; the lowest total picks 1.01), so the 94.8 put him at 1132.52, 17.6 above Snipe58 at the 1.01 and still holding the 1.02.

StealingGas beat fumbduckdumbfuck 126.26 to 89.1 in the Match of the Week, with Puka Nacua at 35.0, and his run of top scores ended at two when three teams finished ahead of him. He is 6-3 and 2nd, and his 1.10 now sits 2.84 MAXPF points above Hades9mm's 1.09. Zygon is 8-1 with the highest MAXPF, 1561.24, and the 1.12, and plays StealingGas in Week 10. Painty69 left 69.36 on the bench in a 50.58-point loss to CMac91, the biggest margin of the week.
